body: add <count> --tag X (subject omitted) now locks <count> DIFFERENT auto-picked subjects to one style, instead of the old (wrong-for-this-case) meaning of X as one of <count> styles for a single auto-picked subject. Resolves/creates the style once up front; never repeats a subject within the sweep or one that already has it. pickSubject gained an extraExclude param. Live-verified: add 3 --tag "game sprite" queued Raccoon/Aphrodite/Mr. T, first published at okemily.com/prompt-o-verse/raccoon-game-sprite/. Documented in --help, docs/COMMANDS.md, README.md. Commits emily.cli 88da91c, 9949557.
title: Style sweeps: add <count> --tag X with no subject
